notes: Duplicates: the gear-lathe photo played at #10 and #18, the white valve slide at #102 and #140, and the bandsaw at #15, #139 and #152. Too many white or unreadable scans: the crystal diagram (#111), the valve slide, the stereo pair at #105 and the SEM sphere at #84. Modern pictures in a historic scene: the 1950s Kokomo courthouse (#48, #147) and a modern veteran-car run with a painted road line (#98). Smaller faults: the flying-saucer-like polished disc (#57), stray signatures on illustrations (#131, #142), and two shots sharing one insert photo (#128, #134). Fixed by new illustrations, a words card or a different photo. The replacement illustrations and photos were not re-viewed. The episode still has many words cards (54) and several long shots.
lessons: Modern photos break a historic scene; use an illustration.
Avoid stereo pairs, doubled scans and white diagrams as full-screen photos.
Do not repeat a photo within 30 shots or use it more than twice.
Check illustrations for stray signatures in the corners.
